title: Bulgogi-Style Marinated Tofu with Rice and Greens
summary: A vegan Korean-inspired dinner with tofu glazed in a sweet-savoury bulgogi-style marinade, served over fluffy rice with garlicky greens. It is weeknight-friendly, filling, and full of sesame, ginger and soy flavour.

ingredients.name: firm tofu, pressed and cut into cubes

steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear, then cook it with 600 ml water and a pinch of the salt in a covered pan or rice cooker until tender and fluffy, about 12–15 minutes plus 5 minutes resting time.
In a bowl, mix the soy sauce, sesame oil, brown sugar, rice vinegar, grated ginger, half the minced garlic, chilli powder, black pepper and half the sesame seeds until the sugar dissolves.
Add the pressed tofu cubes to the marinade and turn gently to coat. Leave to marinate for at least 10 minutes while the rice cooks, turning once if possible.

Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Lift the tofu from the marinade, reserving the marinade, and fry for 8–10 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned on several sides.
Pour the reserved marinade into the pan and bubble for 2–3 minutes, tossing the tofu, until the sauce thickens slightly and coats the cubes in a glossy glaze.

Meanwhile, heat the remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil in another pan over medium heat. Add the remaining garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the spinach and remaining salt. Stir-fry for 2–3 minutes until just wilted and bright green.
Divide the rice between bowls, top with the garlicky spinach and bulgogi-style tofu, then finish with sliced spring onions and the remaining sesame seeds.
